releaseNotes:
• Zero Typing Delay: Cached clipboard IPC and optimized suggestions pipeline for ultra-fast, stutter-free typing
• 100% Reliable Stickers in WhatsApp & Chats: Universal transparent PNG sticker delivery so stickers always show crystal clear with no blank bubbles
• 3-4 Word Custom Stickers: Multi-line balanced auto-scaling fits 3-4 words without clipping
• Auto-Capitalization on Backspace: Reverts automatically to Capital/Shift when deleting back to empty input or sentence start
• Sleek OLED Pitch Black Default Theme: Matches the dark graphite Gboard aesthetic with clean white accents and black return arrow
